activity.notes: Antoni Gaudí took over the Sagrada Família project in 1883 and remained its defining architect until his death in 1926. ATLAS uses this exceptionally well-documented 43-year architectural Activity as the representative Spanish polity link, rather than treating every separate Gaudí commission as an independent Activity.

sources.title: Antoni Gaudí — Sagrada Família
sources.citation_text: The Sagrada Família states that Gaudí took over the project in 1883 and continued his work on it until his death in 1926.

sources.title: Works of Antoni Gaudí — UNESCO World Heritage Centre
sources.citation_text: UNESCO recognizes seven Gaudí works as an exceptional creative contribution to architecture and construction technology of the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.
